name: file-tools
description: Precise MCP file operations and bounded commands for local and SSH workspaces.

interface.shortDescription: Precisely inspect and update local or SSH workspaces
interface.longDescription: Work with UTF-8 text files and foreground commands in an explicit local or SSH workspace. Read line windows or tails, make uniqueness-checked edits, apply preflighted multi-file patches, replace complete files intentionally, and run bounded diagnostics with controlled input and output.
defaultPrompt: Inspect and safely update files in an explicit workspace.
Apply a structured multi-file patch over SSH.
Run a bounded diagnostic command in a selected workspace.
